title: C: Queue (Array)
description: Implement a queue data structure using a circular array with enqueue and dequeue operations.

steps.title: Queue Operations
steps.description: Define a `Queue` struct with int array, front, rear, and size. Implement `void enqueue(Queue *q, int val)` and `int dequeue(Queue *q)`. Enqueue 10, 20, 30, dequeue once, and print the remaining elements.
hints: Enqueue at rear, dequeue from front.

verification.failureMessage: Dequeue should return 10, front should be 20
